lines: Today you wake up... with a *thousand* I.Q.
Breakfast is easy. You read the cereal box once, then fix the toaster *with a spoon*. It has never worked so well.
At school, the exam takes four seconds. You finish, hand it in, and politely correct the teacher's *textbook*.
Outside, you can see everything. You tell your friend: in three seconds, a pigeon will land on your head.
But who is the stranger in the black car... writing down every answer you give?
Follow and comment... for part two!
